g.text: Lab 3.4 — App Service: plan, slots, VNet integration
The plan is the thing you pay for, and VNet integration is outbound only
1 · One plan carries the app and every slot
You pay for the plan, not per slot — the staging
Inbound still arrives from the internet.
To close inbound you need a private endpoint,
2 · A swap redirects traffic, it does not redeploy
Rollback is the same operation run again — the previous build is still there, warm, in the other slot.
az CLI — deploy to the slot, then swap
az webapp deployment slot swap -g dev-skycraft-swc-rg \
